meta.name: security-audit
meta.description: Security guidance and vulnerability review for codebases, APIs, services, CLI tools, libraries, and daemons. Use for security questions, focused reviews, vulnerability research, security audits, or pen tests. Run the complete workflow only for explicit codebase audit or pen-test requests, full/comprehensive/end-to-end reviews, or requested report artifacts.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 排查代码与接口中的安全隐患,给出可执行的修复建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在发版前或收到安全要求时,对代码库、接口或服务做一次安全排查
copy.tagline_en: Scan code, APIs and services for security flaws and get actionable fixes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a security review of your code, API or service before release

howto.what: Claude 会审查代码库、API、服务、CLI 工具等,找出越过真实信任边界的漏洞,并给出源码证据、安全复现方式、优先级和最小修复建议。默认只当参考指南,不会自动跑完整流程或写文件。
howto.when: 当你提出安全疑问、要求聚焦审查或漏洞研究时接管;只有明确要求审计或渗透测试代码库、要求完整或端到端审查、或需要报告文件时,才跑完整六阶段流程。

say.text: 帮我审查这个仓库的认证逻辑,只做聚焦审查,别写报告文件。
say.note: 走指南模式,只看相关部分,不生成产物。

say.text: 对这个代码库做一次完整安全审计,输出报告文件。
say.note: 进入完整审计模式,跑六个阶段并写文件。

say.text: 用 quick 配置扫一遍这个小项目。
say.note: 按 quick 配置做有限范围的首轮检查。

howto.what_en: Claude reviews codebases, APIs, services, and CLI tools for vulnerabilities crossing a real trust boundary, reports source evidence, safe reproduction, priority, and the smallest fix. By default it only advises — no full workflow, no files.
howto.when_en: It takes over for security questions, focused reviews, or vulnerability research; the full six-phase audit runs only when you ask to audit or pen-test a codebase, or request report artifacts.

say_en.text: Review the auth logic in this repo as a focused review, no report files.
say_en.note: Guidance mode only; no artifacts written.

say_en.text: Run a full security audit of this codebase and write the report.
say_en.note: Full audit mode: all six phases and files.

say_en.text: Do a quick-profile pass over this small project.
say_en.note: Bounded first look under the quick profile.
